messages:
Priya N: hi team — I'm onboarding this week and will be shadowing the overnight shift. who should i page if something noisy pops at 02:00 PT? also any must-read runbook sections i should skim now?

Alex K: hey @Priya N welcome! i'm primary for tonight (02:00–10:00 PT). jamal is secondary. page `#pager` or use `/page jamal` if i'm unresponsive. i'll send the quick handoff checklist below.

Jamal D: +1. if it's a degradation vs outage, use the 'tier-2-deg' play. if you see 5xx spike + >50% request drop, escalate immediately. i'll be on-call via phone if you escalate after 03:30.

Priya N: thanks. can you drop the handoff checklist? i want to make sure i know the signal/noise and what to run first.

Alex K: pasted — quick handoff (also pinned in #eng-oncall):

```
Handoff checklist (quick):
- Confirm primary/secondary & contact numbers
- Check active incidents: https://redwood-infra/incidents/live
- Look at SLO dashboard: dashboards/redwood/slo-latency (last 60m)
- Run `curl -s https://health.redwood/api/health | jq .` to check core services
- If paging: gather traces (link from alert) + top 3 services by error
- Notify Customer Success if customer-impact label present
- If escalation required: @pager then @ops-sre on-call
```

Tara L: add runbook sections: "Paging & Triage" and "KV Cache Warmup" are high value for nights. start with runbook anchors: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/paging#triage and https://docs.redwood/runbooks/cache#warmup

Incident Bot: ALERT: [PAGER] high-5xx-rate on model-inference-prod detected at 2026-03-14T01:58:32Z. Severity: P2. Triggered by: 5xx-rate > 10% for 5m. Incident ID: INC-20260314-1183.

Priya N: got it — what do i open first? logs or deployment view?

Alex K: logs + traces first for root cause. open the incident page, copy the top 3 service IDs into `otel->trace` and check live traces. if trace sampling is low, run a quick synthetic against model-inference-prod to reproduce.

Jamal D: also hit the autoscaler dashboard — sometimes a misconfig causes pods to fail during scale-up. look for OOM/killed entries in pod events.

Priya N: i'll try the reproduce step. one more: if i need to escalate to dedicated fallback model, what's the safe command?

Alex K: use the rollout API: `POST /api/rollouts/fallback` with body `{ "service": "model-inference-prod", "variant": "fast-safe-v2" }`. only do if latency < 500ms target is breached for >10m and error persists after rollback attempts. ping me + @Jamal before flip.

Tara L: and remember to annotate the incident with customer-impact = none/partial/full. if partial/full, @Samira R will auto-assign customer-notify. link: https://docs.redwood/ops/incident-annotations

Ops Bot: NOTE: On-call gap detected — weekend rotation next Sat has only one primary assigned (no secondary). Please coordinate a swap if you can cover.

Samira R: re: coverage gap — i'm coordinating a volunteer list. Priya, if you want extra shadow shifts, say which date(s) you can cover and i'll pair you with a buddy. also all: we prefer two-person coverage nights for first 3 months of onboarding.

Priya N: i can take a shadow shift this Saturday (2026-03-21). would love to pair with @Alex K.

Alex K: sounds good. i'll schedule a 30m pre-shift sync at 21:30 PT to walk through common alerts and the escalation flow.

Jamal D: for boarding notes — priya, save these quick commands: 
- `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide` 
- `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-inference --tail 200` 
- `redis-cli -h cache-main info`

Priya N: thanks. can we roleplay a paging scenario during the shadow shift? i learn faster with a fake alert.

Tara L: absolutely. we'll trigger a low-risk alert (no customer impact) at 22:15 and run through the triage steps. i'll coordinate the synthetic and then we'll de-escalate. :white_check_mark:

Incident Bot: TEST ALERT: synthetic-pager (no-impact) scheduled at 2026-03-21T22:15:00Z for shadow drill.

Samira R: great — i'll add the drill to your onboarding checklist and loop in the on-call trainer channel. Priya, bring your questions; we'll review post-drill notes and update runbook gaps.

Priya N: perfect. one last ask — where do i log handoff notes after my shift?

Alex K: add a short note in the thread pinned to that day's timestamp and update the rota doc: https://docs.redwood/oncall/rota (section "daily-handoff-notes"). Example: '02:00–10:00 PT — no customer impact; saw brief 5xx blip caused by scale fail; escalated to rollback; resolved by 03:24; follow-up: increase pod readiness probe timeout.'

Jamal D: and include any flaky alerts so we can tune thresholds.

Priya N: thanks everyone — feel much better. see you on Sat for the shadow shift. :rocket:
